name: Blombos Cave ochre-rich mixture
description: Two shell containers and associated tools preserve evidence of preparing and storing an ochre-rich mixture.

impact.note: One cave's toolkit shows pigment compounding and storage; a modest ability with no known line of descent from this community.

date.label: Approximately 100,000 years ago
date.basis: Date describes the reported event or archaeological context, not the origin of the general technique.

events.statement: The authors report two associated shell containers and tools in an approximately 100,000-year-old ochre-processing context.

evidence.supports: The authors report two associated shell containers and tools in an approximately 100,000-year-old ochre-processing context.

earliest_record.rationale: First researched event for this local case; it does not establish worldwide priority.

caveats: The users and final function of the mixture are unknown; its use as paint, body decoration or adhesive is not demonstrated.

research.note: Independent review checked the archaeological paper: production and curation are interpreted, while the final use is not established.
